question: How does abstaining from food by day lead to overcoming death by aging?
premises: Death associated with age is the target
inference: Through daily abstention from food, one will overcome death by aging
uncertainties: divasāt nāśanena could mean fasting during the day rather than complete non-eating
gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is idiomatically unusual and may mean going beyond death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will overcome death by aging.
